description: This file defines an enumeration 'MetricDirection' in Java which specifies the direction of a counter, used for distinguishing inbound and outbound message counts within the context of the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: MetricDirection
classes.description: An enum representing the direction of a metric, either INBOUND or OUTBOUND, with methods to retrieve the direction name and find a direction based on a name.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name label of the MetricDirection instance.

methods.name: forName
methods.description: Static method that returns an Optional<MetricDirection> matching the provided name, case sensitive, using a stream filter.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides Object's toString to return the name label.
